headline: National Park Entry Fees and Beach Access
reservation: Entry requires a valid Parks Canada pass, which can be purchased at the gate or online; this is separate from any camping or cottage bookings. During peak summer months, specific areas may reach capacity, so check the Parks Canada PEI social media or website for real-time updates. Accommodation within Cavendish is highly seasonal and requires booking months in advance.

days.title: Sandstone Cliffs and Dunes

stops.name: Cavendish Beach Main
stops.detail: Walk the extensive boardwalks protecting the fragile dune system and access the white sand shore.

stops.name: Dunelands Trail
stops.detail: Follow this scenic loop to view the freshwater ponds and the shifting sands that define the North Shore ecosystem.

days.driving: Allow 45 to 60 minutes from the capital; seasonal traffic in Cavendish can be heavy.
days.note: Stay on marked boardwalks to prevent erosion of the protected marram grass dunes.

days.title: North Shore Coastal Drive

stops.name: Gulf Shore Parkway
stops.detail: Drive or cycle this scenic route offering multiple pull-outs for views of the red sandstone cliffs.

stops.name: Oceanview Lookout
stops.detail: Stop at this elevated point for a panoramic view of the Atlantic and the varying colors of the island's coastline.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for a leisurely transit with multiple photo stops along the Parkway.
days.note: The Parkway features a dedicated lane for cyclists; maintain awareness when turning into overlooks.

days.title: Maritime Heritage and Salt Air

stops.name: North Rustico Beach
stops.detail: Visit this quieter section of the park located near a historic fishing village for calm waters and views of the harbor breakwater.

stops.name: Skmaqn—Port-la-Joye—Fort Amherst National Historic Site
stops.detail: Travel south to explore the layered history of Mi'kmaw, French, and British presence on the island.

days.driving: Allow 1.5 hours total driving between the North Shore and the historic sites near Rocky Point.
days.note: Verify seasonal interpretive program schedules at the historic sites before visiting.

intel.title: Beach Lots
intel.text: The main Cavendish Beach lot is large but can reach capacity by midday in July and August. Smaller lots like North Rustico offer alternative access points.

intel.title: Regional Coverage
intel.text: Cellular reception is generally excellent throughout the Cavendish area and along the Gulf Shore Parkway. Public Wi-Fi is occasionally available at main visitor facilities.

intel.title: Cavendish Services
intel.text: Fuel and groceries are readily available in the town of Cavendish and nearby North Rustico. Most facilities are seasonal and may close or reduce hours after September.

intel.title: Seasonal Hours
intel.text: Full park services including lifeguards and washrooms are typically available from late June through Labor Day. Off-season visitors will find most gates open but facilities closed.

intel.title: Accessibility Features
intel.text: Cavendish Beach offers beach wheelchairs and accessible boardwalks at specific locations. Check with the visitor center for the exact availability of mobility aids.

plan.arrival: Pick up your vehicle at Charlottetown Airport (YYG) and stop at a major supermarket in Charlottetown before the 40km drive north.
plan.vehicle: Standard passenger cars are ideal; the region's roads are well-paved, though RVs should stick to the main Parkway and designated campground loops.
plan.goldenHour: Oceanview Lookout provides a clear view of the sun setting over the Gulf of St. Lawrence during the summer months.
